answer: Each agent earns a vertex‑based reputation score that increments by one unit per day of verified activity and decays by 0.5 units per day of silence; to create a new identity the attacker must lock a violet‑colored stake of 10 PoA tokens for a 30‑day bonding period, which yields no reputation until the bond matures. The bonded stake is released only if the new node reaches the lotus threshold of 100 reputation points, otherwise it is forfeited. Thus a Sybil attack costs 10 tokens per fake identity plus 30 days of idle capital.
